title: Ledger and Will
author: Jude Amberdale
blurb: Edmund Ashgrove, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
